test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. I kept quiet about it though because I didn't want to sound grumpy.

B. We were helping at a nature reserve for a week.

C. I was getting a bit fed up because we had cheese sandwiches for every meal as the cooking team knew no better.

D. When it was my team's turn to cook, we made a simple dinner of pasta and salad which was devoured in no time.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. "BCAD." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence B is the first sentence. It begins with the pronoun 'We' and gives a general description that the author and his group members were helping at a nature reserve.
 
• Sentence C is the second sentence & begins with the pronoun 'I' and mentions a particular concern the author faced during that time which is he got fed UP with eating the same meal for a long time.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 2.
 
• Sentence A is the third sentence. It begins with the pronoun 'I' and further explains what the author did regarding the issue he faced.
 
• Sentence D is the last sentence as it begins with the adverb 'When' and mentions further when their turn of cooking came and they cooked a simple meal i.e., pasta and salad that was loved by everyone.
 
• The correct arrangement is BCAD.

 

The correct order is:__ 

 
• B. We were helping at a nature reserve for a week.
 
• C. I was getting a bit fed up because we had cheese sandwiches for every meal as the cooking team knew no better.
 
• A. I kept quiet about it though because I didn't want to sound grumpy.
 
• D. When it was my team's turn to cook, we made a simple dinner of pasta and salad which was devoured in no time.
